The '''Stone Fireplace''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that can be purchased for {{Price|1500}} from the [[Carpenter's Shop]] any day that it is open.  It can also be purchased from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

[[Furniture#Fireplaces|Fireplaces]] cannot be placed outside. Once placed, right-clicking on it will turn the fire on or off.

Players who select the Hill-top or Wilderness [[Farm Maps|farm map]] during character creation will have one inside their [[Farmhouse|house]] when the game begins.
